item.text:
Continued the refactor by separating graph data loading from graph representation selection.

[MstApplication.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/026_prims_mst/MstApplication.java:1) now orchestrates four explicit steps: load an [AdjacencyMatrixSource.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/026_prims_mst/AdjacencyMatrixSource.java:1), build a `Graph` through [GraphFactory.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/026_prims_mst/GraphFactory.java:1), run the MST algorithm, then format the result. The sample input moved to [SampleAdjacencyMatrixSource.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/026_prims_mst/SampleAdjacencyMatrixSource.java:1), and neighbor-list graph creation is now isolated in [NeighborListGraphFactory.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/026_prims_mst/NeighborListGraphFactory.java:1). [MST.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/026_prims_mst/MST.java:5) wires those dependencies together explicitly.

That removes the previous coupling where the source class also decided the in-memory graph shape.
